title: KeyRevocationView
description: Read-optimized projection of an imagodei KeyRevocation DHT entry. Source of truth: DHT. Rebuildable via signal replay on RecoveryV2Signal::KeyRevocationRequested/Effective.

dhtAnchorHash.description: Holochain ActionHash of the KeyRevocation entry (base64).

humanId.description: String id of the human whose key is being revoked.

reason.description: One of REVOCATION_REASONS: compromised, stolen, challenge_upheld, voluntary.

requiredVotes.description: Votes required to reach threshold. 1 for voluntary; >=2 for steward_vote/challenge.

thresholdReached.description: True when currentVotes >= requiredVotes and the revocation is effective.

effectiveAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when revocation became effective. Null while pending.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last update (e.g., when threshold was reached).
